info.name: Box Authorize Authorization Metadata Cascade Policies API

params.name: folder_id
params.description:
Specifies which folder to return policies for. This can not be used on the
root folder with ID `0`.

params.name: owner_enterprise_id
params.description:
The ID of the enterprise ID for which to find metadata
cascade policies. If not specified, it defaults to the
current enterprise.

params.name: marker
params.description:
Defines the position marker at which to begin returning results. This is
used when paginating using marker-based pagination.

This requires `usemarker` to be set to `true`.

params.name: offset
params.description:
The offset of the item at which to begin the response.

Queries with offset parameter value
exceeding 10000 will be rejected
with a 400 response.

items.docs:
Retrieves a list of all the metadata cascade policies
that are applied to a given folder. This can not be used on the root
folder with ID `0`.

Creates a new metadata cascade policy that applies a given
metadata template to a given folder and automatically
cascades it down to any files within that folder.

In order for the policy to be applied a metadata instance must first
be applied to the folder the policy is to be applied to.

params.name: metadata_cascade_policy_id
params.description: The ID of the metadata cascade policy.

items.docs: Retrieve a specific metadata cascade policy assigned to a folder.

params.name: metadata_cascade_policy_id
params.description: The ID of the metadata cascade policy.

info.name: Box Force-apply metadata cascade policy to folder

params.name: metadata_cascade_policy_id
params.description: The ID of the cascade policy to force-apply.

items.docs:
Force the metadata on a folder with a metadata cascade policy to be applied to
all of its children. This can be used after creating a new cascade policy to
enforce the metadata to be cascaded down to all existing files within that
folder.
